request.state: Verified examples distinguish infrastructure and domain transitions. Grant reviewer decision validates actor, current assignment, work eligibility, application state and money before committing; its email handler only finds the current saved request ID and stores its status. Propose salesperson send freezes a nonempty unexpired authorized offer; its mail state maps success to delivered, while PDF completion validates source/revision and stores an authorized finalized file. Mail receive requires staff and current location/service entitlement; it records a dispatched notice ID, and matching completion may advance physical-item state from received to notified. A reminder replaces that current ID. Separately, the standard runtime owns durable delivery IDs, status/result/error, final localized message content, retry identity and uncertainty handling; initial send yields id/status. Receipts ordinarily last at least seven days and retained payloads still obey access and expiration. The design is not implemented. A new delivery(operation) reference could follow existing action(operation) type notation, but its ownership, retention and observation semantics must be specified. Required outcome is less duplicated transport tracking without implicit approval/payment/file attachment, stale callback effects, profile leaks or added deployment configuration. No performance or usability evidence is claimed.

association.instructions: Which alternative should be pinned as the canonical draft direction rather than merely presented as a possibility?

criteria.typed_reference: Add one opaque target-indexed delivery type usable as a nullable stored reference. send supplies it; protected status/result/error are observations of the original runtime receipt. Keep non-sensitive outcome metadata for retained associations and redact/expire other contents. Domain versions change only for authored domain writes. Correlation still explicitly compares the stored handle ID in any business callback; notifications or PDFs never change domain success automatically. New type/read-lifetime semantics are the cost.
criteria.associated_effect: Let send name a destination record field, synthesize associated status/result slots, and offer completion handling scoped directly to that field. It removes both mirror assignments and ID lookup text, while requiring new syntax and a specification of automatic storage changes, locks and callback ordering. Payload privacy and receipt retention remain obligations.
criteria.explicit_mirrors: Stay with manual per-model ID/status fields and ordinary completion handlers; centralize only captions and standardized failure meanings. This avoids expanding the type/effect system and leaves each business update explicit, at the cost of maintaining duplicate receipt information and current-attempt correlation repeatedly.
